clue.text: Religious leader comes from high top into river

indicators.note: into says the high top is put inside the river's name

parts.note: the Wye is a river on the England-Wales border
a cliff is a high, steep rock face or summit

explanation.surface: A churchman descends from a lofty peak into a river.
explanation.walkthrough: John Wycliffe was the 14th-century English reformer behind the first English Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: John Wycliffe was an English reformer and theologian, a leading figure of medieval religion.

clue.text: Stand for something or other

definitions.meaning: a stand of open shelves for ornaments
used loosely for unspecified other things

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a Victorian shelved stand, and a vague word for various other things.

clue.text: They take the measure of high jinks I'll get caught up in

indicators.note: get caught says I'll is trapped inside the word for high jinks

parts.note: capers are pranks or high jinks

indicators.note: in a down clue up says the letters read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: I'll gives ILL without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Measuring officials get mixed up in pranks.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' reads I'll from the bottom, giving LLI; 'high jinks' hides the pranks word, not a measuring sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Callipers are instruments used for measuring thickness and diameters.

clue.text: Since being sacked, one's outside in the cold

indicators.note: outside says the letters of one's go around the rest

parts.note: one is I, and one's gives IS

indicators.note: being sacked suggests disorder, as a looted city is wrecked

explanation.surface: Since losing their job, someone is left out in the cold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sacked' looks like losing a job, but here it means plundered and wrecked, so SINCE becomes CINES.
explanation.definitionFit: Iciness is coldness, the state of being freezing.

clue.text: Islands' cost of travel increased, we're told

indicators.note: we're told means the phrase is heard spoken, not seen

parts.note: the fare rose

explanation.surface: The islands' ferry prices have gone up, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: The Faeroes are a group of North Atlantic islands belonging to Denmark.

clue.text: Well-constructed answer finally entered in examination

indicators.note: entered in says the final letter goes inside the word for examination

parts.note: a study is a close examination of something

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word answer

explanation.surface: A solid answer is given at the end of an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sturdy is strongly built, so robust and well made.

clue.text: One in large family clan allowed to stay at university

indicators.note: to stay says the university word lodges inside the others

parts.note: a sept is a clan or branch of a family, especially in Ireland
let means allowed
being up means in residence at university, in British usage

explanation.surface: A family group is permitted to remain at college.
explanation.definitionFit: A septuplet is one of seven siblings born at one birth, a large family indeed.

clue.text: After hesitation, refuse to admit one Italian

indicators.note: after says the following material comes behind the hesitation sound

parts.note: um is a sound of hesitation

indicators.note: to admit says one goes inside the word for refuse

parts.note: bran is husks, refuse from milling grain
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: After some hesitation, a person refuses entry to an Italian.
explanation.definitionFit: An Umbrian comes from Umbria, a region of central Italy.

clue.text: Detective takes horse to look at briefly

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector
a pinto is a piebald horse

explanation.surface: A detective gets a horse to inspect quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: To dip into a book is to read bits of it casually.

clue.text: Really angry as no one's keeping job in revolution

parts.note: if all have been fired, nobody keeps their job
people who are up are in revolt, risen against rulers

explanation.surface: A workforce sacked during an uprising is understandably furious.
explanation.definitionFit: Being all fired up is an idiom for being highly roused, excited or furious.

clue.text: Head of bakery bringing back say Bath buns

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of bakery
bringing back turns the spa word round to read the other way

parts.note: Bath is an English spa town, and say marks it as an example of a spa

explanation.surface: The head baker is bringing back, for example, Bath buns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bath buns' looks like one item, but Bath is the spa and buns is the definition. A BAP is a soft British bread roll.
explanation.definitionFit: Baps are soft flat bread rolls, a kind of bun in British usage.

clue.text: Top man runs back — so defective an answer sounds unwanted

parts.note: number one, written NO 1, is the top man

indicators.note: back says the word for runs is read the other way round

parts.note: lopes means runs with long strides

indicators.note: defective says the answer is lacking the word so

parts.note: a solution is an answer to a problem
taken as written

explanation.surface: A boss sprints back because his answer is faulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns LOPES into SEPOL; SOLUTION less SO leaves LUTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Noise pollution is a term for unwanted sounds, from traffic, aircraft and the like.

clue.text: Causes misery, cutting girl's hair

indicators.note: cutting says the girl's name is removed from the longer word

parts.note: distresses means causes misery or suffering
Di is a girl's name, and with the possessive it gives DIS

explanation.surface: Something causes grief by snipping a young woman's locks.
explanation.definitionFit: Tresses are long locks, a literary word for a woman's hair.

clue.text: In fact, feel initially useless, struggling to be productive

indicators.note: struggling suggests the letters are writhing into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of useless

explanation.surface: In reality, feeling useless at first, someone struggles to get work done.
explanation.definitionFit: Effectual means producing the intended effect, so effective.

clue.text: Death Valley corporal enters in delight

indicators.note: enters in says the corporal goes inside the word for delight

parts.note: glee is delight or joy
a corporal is a non-commissioned officer, NCO

explanation.surface: A soldier delights in visiting the Californian desert.
explanation.walkthrough: Glencoe is the Scottish glen of the 1692 massacre of the MacDonalds, hence 'Death Valley'; the surface wants the American desert.
explanation.definitionFit: Glencoe is a Scottish glen remembered for the 1692 massacre, so a valley of slaughter.

clue.text: Steroid is not bad, injected into heart

indicators.note: injected into says the scrambled letters go inside the word for heart

parts.note: the core is the heart of something

indicators.note: bad means the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: A steroid is safe enough when injected into the heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is not bad' reads as a verdict on the drug, but 'bad' is the anagram signal making TISON.
explanation.definitionFit: Cortisone is a corticosteroid hormone used against inflammation.

clue.text: Finish knitting unwanted garment

definitions.meaning: to finish a piece of knitting by securing the stitches
clothing discarded by its former owner

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: knitters end work by casting off, and hand-me-down clothes are castoffs.

clue.text: Create consternation, pocketing soldiers' kit

indicators.note: pocketing says the outer word takes the soldiers inside it

parts.note: to appal is to dismay or horrify
RE is the Royal Engineers, British army soldiers

explanation.surface: Soldiers stealing equipment causes alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparel is clothing, as kit is the clothes for a sport or job.

clue.text: Most of the secret is in what one adds to paint

indicators.note: most of says the last letter of the is dropped

parts.note: inner means private or secret, as in inner thoughts

explanation.surface: The secret of good painting lies in what you mix into the colours.
explanation.definitionFit: Thinner is a solvent added to paint to dilute it.

clue.text: To be pessimistic, a pair needs breather, being out of energy

parts.note: a pair is two

indicators.note: being out of says the energy letter is dropped from the word for breather

parts.note: a breather is a rest
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Two people need a break because they have run out of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying at worst means taking the most pessimistic view of how things could turn out.

clue.text: Have success that's very short, being in pain

indicators.note: being in says the middle pieces go inside the word for pain

parts.note: an ache is a pain
ie, id est, means that is
V is the short form of very

explanation.surface: Success is fleeting when you are hurting.
explanation.definitionFit: To achieve is to succeed in reaching a goal.

clue.text: Labour's concession for English town

parts.note: labour is work; the possessive adds no letter here
a sop is a small concession made to appease someone

explanation.surface: The Labour party offers a sop to one English town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' suggests the British political party; Worksop is a town in Nottinghamshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Worksop is a market town in Nottinghamshire in England.

clue.text: Fierce woman exhausts son, drinking gallons

indicators.note: drinking says the outer words swallow the gallons letter

parts.note: tires means exhausts

explanation.surface: A ferocious woman wears out her son by downing gallons.
explanation.definitionFit: A tigress is figuratively a fierce, aggressive woman.

clue.text: Leader in People's Daily (China) about food introducing note ideal for the ladies

indicators.note: leader in picks the first letter of People's
food is introducing the note, so the note sits inside it

parts.note: rice is a staple food
a daily, or char, is a British cleaning woman who comes in each day
Ming is fine Chinese porcelain

explanation.surface: A Chinese newspaper runs a story about food.
explanation.walkthrough: People's Daily is China's party newspaper, but here Daily is CHAR, a charwoman, and China is MING porcelain.
explanation.definitionFit: Prince Charming is the fairy-tale hero, a byword for a woman's perfect suitor.

clue.text: Crooner wanted to hold another singer back

indicators.note: back says the held letters are read the other way round
the words crooner wanted hold the letters inside them

explanation.surface: A crooner wanted to keep another vocalist in the background.
explanation.definitionFit: The wren is a small songbird, so a singer of a different kind from a crooner.

clue.text: Being a teenager is such stress?

definitions.meaning: a teenager is aged under twenty, under a score
to ... a point is to stress it

explanation.walkthrough: A score is twenty, so a teenager is under score.
explanation.definitionFit: To underscore means to emphasise, and teens are below a score of years.

clue.text: More than one rook up, all went wrong

indicators.note: went wrong says these letters are thrown into disorder

parts.note: R is the chess abbreviation for rook
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: With the rook advanced, everything in the chess game went wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'went wrong' scrambles R, UP and ALL.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural is the grammatical form for more than one.

clue.text: Shirk chores? So one has no defence

definitions.meaning: one who has no defence is unable to protect oneself

explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words, help less is what a chore-shirker does.
explanation.definitionFit: Helpless describes someone defenceless, unable to protect themselves.
